description: Unit tests for the SpdyStream class in the Chromium networking code, testing various aspects of SPDY protocol stream handling including request/response flow, error handling, timing, flow control, and trailers.

classes.name: SpdyStreamTest
classes.description: Test fixture for SPDY stream unit tests, providing setup, utility methods, and test helpers.

classes.name: SpdyStreamTestWithMockClock
classes.description: Derived test fixture that uses a mock clock to test timing-related features of SPDY streams.

classes.name: StreamDelegateWithTrailers
classes.description: Delegate class that captures trailers received on a SPDY stream.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDetectEOF
classes.description: Delegate class that detects EOF on a SPDY stream.

classes.name: StreamDelegateSendImmediate
classes.description: Delegate class that sends data immediately and waits for stream closure.

classes.name: StreamDelegateConsumeData
classes.description: Delegate class that consumes data from a SPDY stream.

methods.name: SendDataAfterOpen
methods.description: Test sending data after opening a SPDY stream and receiving response.

methods.name: BrokenConnectionDetectionSuccessfulRequest
methods.description: Test detection of broken connection during a request.

methods.name: Trailers
methods.description: Test handling of trailers received on a SPDY stream.

methods.name: StreamError
methods.description: Test handling of stream errors and protocol errors.

methods.name: SendLargeDataAfterOpenRequestResponse
methods.description: Test sending large data blocks in request/response streams.

methods.name: SendLargeDataAfterOpenBidirectional
methods.description: Test sending large data blocks in bidirectional streams.

methods.name: UpperCaseHeaders
methods.description: Test protocol error on headers with uppercase ASCII characters.

methods.name: HeadersMustHaveStatus
methods.description: Test protocol error when response headers lack :status.

methods.name: StatusMustBeNumber
methods.description: Test protocol error when :status is not a number.

methods.name: StatusCannotHaveExtraText
methods.description: Test protocol error when :status contains extra text.

methods.name: StatusMustBePresent
methods.description: Test protocol error when :status header is missing.

methods.name: TrailersMustNotFollowTrailers
methods.description: Test protocol error when trailers follow trailers.

methods.name: DataMustNotFollowTrailers
methods.description: Test protocol error when data follows trailers.

methods.name: DelegateIsInformedOfEOF
methods.description: Test that delegate is notified of EOF.

methods.name: ReceivedBytes
methods.description: Test calculation of total bytes received from network.

methods.name: DataOnHalfClosedRemoveStream
methods.description: Test behavior when data arrives on a half-closed stream.

methods.name: FlowControlSlowReads
methods.description: Test flow control behavior with slow reads and window updates.

methods.name: RunResumeAfterUnstallRequestResponseTest
methods.description: Helper to test stream resumption after stall/unstall in request/response streams.

methods.name: RunResumeAfterUnstallBidirectionalTest
methods.description: Helper to test stream resumption after stall/unstall in bidirectional streams.
